coinbase_balance.rationale: Reviewed: read-only account balance data; governed for exact schema validation and deployment policy.

coinbase_convert_execute.rationale: Reviewed: executes a quoted currency conversion and moves funds.

coinbase_convert_get.rationale: Reviewed: reads conversion status without moving funds.

coinbase_convert_quote.rationale: Reviewed: produces a non-executing conversion quote.

coinbase_env.rationale: Reviewed: reports configured environment metadata without returning private-key material.

coinbase_fees.rationale: Reviewed: reads the account fee tier and trading volume.

coinbase_help.rationale: Reviewed: returns local command documentation only.

coinbase_orders_cancel.rationale: Reviewed: changes live order state and releases reserved funds; partial batch outcomes are possible.

coinbase_orders_close_position.rationale: Reviewed: submits a market order to flatten all or part of a live position.

coinbase_orders_create.rationale: Reviewed: places a live order that can immediately spend or dispose of assets.

coinbase_orders_edit.rationale: Reviewed: modifies the price or size of a live order and changes market exposure.

coinbase_orders_fills.rationale: Reviewed: reads historical trade executions and fees.

coinbase_orders_get.rationale: Reviewed: reads a single order's state and fills.

coinbase_orders_list.rationale: Reviewed: reads order history and open-order state.

coinbase_orders_preview.rationale: Reviewed: estimates execution, fees, and slippage without placing an order.

coinbase_portfolios_create.rationale: Reviewed: creates a new account portfolio and changes account organization.

coinbase_portfolios_delete.rationale: Reviewed: irreversibly deletes an empty portfolio.

coinbase_portfolios_edit.rationale: Reviewed: renames a portfolio and changes account organization.

coinbase_portfolios_get.rationale: Reviewed: reads portfolio balances, positions, allocation, and PnL.

coinbase_portfolios_list.rationale: Reviewed: lists portfolio identifiers and metadata.

coinbase_products_best_bid_ask.rationale: Reviewed: reads public best-bid and best-ask market data.

coinbase_products_book.rationale: Reviewed: reads public order-book market data.

coinbase_products_candles.rationale: Reviewed: reads public historical candle market data.

coinbase_products_get.rationale: Reviewed: reads public product metadata and pricing.

coinbase_products_ticker.rationale: Reviewed: reads public recent-trade and bid/ask market data.

coinbase_set_env.rationale: Reviewed: changes the CLI execution environment used by later operations and therefore the credential/target context.

coinbase_template.rationale: Reviewed: returns a local request template without sending an API request.
